title: finding(plugin-chatbot): FloatingChatbot silently drops an authored className — a hardcoded literal spreads after chatbotProps
body:
Measured by the `domain:ui` dev seat while implementing objectui#7708 (branch `claude/issue-7708-chatbot-floating-spread-fence`). Filed unassigned, ungraded — triage owns routing. Not fixed there: #7708's scope is `packages/plugin-chatbot/src/renderer.tsx`'s registration-level spread; this finding is one file over, in `FloatingChatbot.tsx`, and predates #7708 (present on `origin/main` before and after that fix — the raw registration spread never carried `className` in the first place, on either side of #7708, since the registration destructures `className` out as its own named prop).

## The fact

`packages/plugin-chatbot/src/FloatingChatbot.tsx`'s render:

```
FloatingChatbotPanel(...)
  ChatbotEnhanced spread of chatbotProps, THEN
    maxHeight fixed to "100%"
    className fixed to the literal "h-full border-0 rounded-none"
```

`className` is a plain, unconditional object-literal override written AFTER `...chatbotProps` in the same JSX element — not merged via `cn()`/`clsx` the way this repo's own styling convention (AGENTS.md #3, "Shadcn-native aesthetics") calls for everywhere else in this package (`ChatbotEnhanced.tsx` merges its own `className` prop with `cn()` throughout). Whatever `className` a `chatbot-floating` node authors — forwarded from the registration as its own named JSX prop on `FloatingChatbot`, landing in `chatbotProps.className` — is silently replaced, never appended, by the two hardcoded panel-fit classes.

## Why it is worth a card

Author-declared `className` on a floating node's authoring face is the styling escape hatch AGENTS.md #3 requires every widget to expose ("Always expose `className` in schema props so users can override via JSON"). On `chatbot-floating` it type-checks, parses, and is silently a no-op on the rendered panel — the DECLARED-BUT-NOT-DELIVERED shape this repo treats as first class (see the `check-handler-key-read-sites.mjs` gate's own framing of the same class of defect, though this instance is a plain prop, not a handler key, so that gate does not see it).

## How it was measured

Static reading of `FloatingChatbot.tsx`'s JSX (later prop always wins over an earlier spread) — not yet confirmed through a live render. That confirmation, and whether the fix is `cn(chatbotProps.className, "h-full border-0 rounded-none")` or something narrower (maybe only specific utility classes should be forced, and the rest should merge), is left to whoever picks this up.

## Not a duplicate

Dedup ran against the repo-scoped open-issue search via `search_issues`, with a lit positive control in the same session — `chatbot-floating` returns 4 results (objectui#7708, #7703, #7655, #1155(closed)), so the zero below is a real reading. The literal panel-fit class string (`"h-full border-0 rounded-none"`) returns 0 hits. objectui#4425 / #4431 (the `toDomProps` DOM-leak family) and objectui#7708 are adjacent but distinct: those are about extra/leaked attributes reaching the DOM, not about a legitimately-declared prop being overridden after being correctly forwarded.

Refs: objectui#7708 (adjacent, not the same defect) · objectui#4425 (adjacent DOM-leak class, different axis).
